title: Gaussian surface area of a centred ball
statement:
Let $n\ge 1$ and $r>0$. The Gaussian surface area of the closed Euclidean ball of radius $r$ centred at the origin in $\mathbb R^n$ is
\[\frac{2^{1-n/2}}{\Gamma(n/2)}\,r^{n-1}e^{-r^2/2}.\]
